news_results.title: Razorpay reports 48% YoY revenue expansion, initiates major engineering hiring drive
news_results.snippet: Razorpay today announced stellar quarter earnings, confirming profitability and announcing plans to hire 250+ senior technical leaders across backend, platform, and applied AI infrastructure.

news_results.title: Razorpay restructures customer ops division to focus on AI automation; tech headcount spared
news_results.snippet: In a strategic realignment, Razorpay confirmed minor operational restructuring in support while expanding investments in core platform engineering and distributed systems.

news_results.title: Leadership update: Razorpay appoints new Chief Technology Officer from Big Tech
news_results.snippet: Former engineering director joins Razorpay to steer global technical architecture and modernize backend microservices stack.
